title: Discord history fetcher: find the busiest day and pull it
summary: Add scripts/proactive_eval/fetch_history.py: scan #general over a lookback window to recommend the busiest day, then pull that full UTC day into a gitignored JSONL fixture plus meta sidecar, reusing DiscordBotClient with mock-transport tests.

title: Ground-truth labeling with Claude Code as the judge
summary: Add label_day.py: chunk the fixture day and drive headless Claude Code (claude -p, JSON output) to label every human message as directed at other_user/anyone/bot/ambient, with per-chunk caching, strict parsing, and a merged labels file.

title: Periodic-activation simulator, bot adapter interface, cost accounting
summary: Add simulate.py plus the ProactiveBotAdapter protocol, a baseline pydantic-ai adapter and a silent adapter: replay the day in cadence windows with injected bot responses, record per-activation token usage, and print/store the day-cost summary with projections.

title: Judge scoring of a simulation run and the final eval report
summary: Add score_run.py: combine deterministic label checks with a Claude Code judge pass over every sent response, compute response precision, violations and misses, and render the final markdown report including the cost summary.
